decisions.reason: The conferencing market remains uncertain and the cost of keeping the service is low, so we retain the option.
The specific adoption in Hong Kong resolves some uncertainty favorably, so we keep and likely invest further.
A dedicated page signals commitment, but prospects are still uncertain, so we keep the option while monitoring.
The portal likely has low maintenance costs and supports customer interactions, so we keep it as a low-cost option.
Carrier pre-selection is a declining service with little uncertainty about its low value, so we drop it to release resources.
Direct voice network connection may still have uncertain B2B value, so we keep the option open.
